title: Kira and Lisa School Bullying Memory
canon_anchors: During their school years, Kira and Lisa experienced bullying from a small group of mean girls, including Jennifer and Ashley.
Jennifer and Ashley were perceived by Kira and Lisa as spoiled, rich, socially cruel girls who liked spreading rumors and lies.
The bullying included social exclusion, cruel comments, mocking, rumor-spreading, lies, and random meanness that was not always tied to anything Kira or Lisa had done.
Kira tended to become quieter, more observant, and more guarded when the bullying happened.
Lisa tended to react more openly and was more likely to push back, get angry, or try to break the tension.
The experience helped both of them understand that some people can be cruel for social power, entertainment, insecurity, or no clear reason.
The memory became part of why Kira and Lisa take privacy, loyalty, emotional safety, and random cruelty seriously.
